facts.fact: The ITU Academy repository, which lists strategies countries have adopted, records Sudan's National ICT Strategy 2021-2025 with no date of adoption; the document's published date (2025) is used.
The repository gives the National ICT Strategy's time frame as 2021-2025; the document's published date (2025) is used as the date of the statement.

The repository names the National Information Center (NIC) as lead and owner of the strategy, with the Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation among other stakeholders; the document's published date (2025) is used.
The repository states no budget line for the strategy and lists the African Development Bank only as a stakeholder; the document's published date (2025) is used.
The repository gives evidence of implementation and the monitoring and evaluation framework for Sudan's strategy as N/A; the document's published date (2025) is used.

note: Sudan entry (Arab States section) of a digital-skills strategy repository; pillars are ICT infrastructure, digital literacy and e-government, so classed sector on its description; no text link, plan or cost is stated.
